runtimePolicy.firstDecision: ambiguous requests declare goal and isQuestion while choosing the first tool or finish in the same response; deterministic backend goals remain authoritative
runtimePolicy.failedSkillHandling: return the error to the model transcript and continue within the bounded loop
runtimePolicy.interruptedRunHandling: needs_review; do not replay unknown side effects

tools.name: get_edit_status

scope.resolution: reads the latest previous scoped Agent task and its safe artifact identifiers

tools.retryPolicy: safe to invoke again; exact status questions use the deterministic explicit path
preconditions: current project, editing task, and conversation are already validated

tools.name: get_asset_health_summary

scope.resolution: reads persisted source-health counts, scan state, and safe reason codes

tools.retryPolicy: safe to invoke again
preconditions: current project is already validated

tools.name: list_assets

scope.resolution: projectId comes from LoopState, not model arguments

tools.retryPolicy: safe to invoke again, but the current loop does not automatically retry a failed skill
preconditions: current project is already validated by the Agent entry point

tools.name: search_assets

scope.resolution: bounded safe candidate search

tools.retryPolicy: safe to invoke again
preconditions: current project is validated

tools.name: search_asset_segments

scope.resolution: evidence-bound source ranges

tools.retryPolicy: safe to invoke again
preconditions: current project is validated

tools.name: search_music

scope.resolution: returns only downloadable CC0 or CC-BY tracks from the configured Provider

tools.retryPolicy: safe to invoke again; the loop does not automatically retry
preconditions: Jamendo client ID is configured

tools.name: get_storyboard

scope.resolution: returns only the active storyboard loaded into LoopState

tools.retryPolicy: safe to invoke again, but the current loop does not automatically retry a failed skill

tools.name: get_timeline

scope.resolution: when timelineVersionId is supplied it must match a scoped timeline; only an omitted id may use the sole scoped timeline

tools.retryPolicy: safe to invoke again, but the current loop does not automatically retry a failed skill

tools.name: get_text_capabilities

scope.resolution: returns backend-owned preview and Jianying delivery recipes

tools.retryPolicy: safe to invoke again; the loop does not automatically retry

tools.name: download_music

scope.resolution: downloads one verified eligible track to a unique project-controlled path

tools.retryPolicy: do not automatically retry; each successful invocation creates a unique local copy
preconditions: track was returned by the configured Jamendo Provider

tools.name: use_online_music

scope.resolution: downloads one eligible track, waits for local analysis, and creates a new scoped timeline version

tools.retryPolicy: do not automatically retry after an unknown interruption
preconditions: a scoped timeline exists
track is eligible
local media analysis completes

tools.name: request_asset_analysis

scope.resolution: projectId comes from LoopState and every requested asset is verified against it

tools.idempotency: ready assets and assets with queued or running analysis are skipped; a failed asset can receive a new analysis task
tools.retryPolicy: do not automatically retry; a fresh request revalidates the current source file and queues only eligible assets
preconditions: assetIds is non-empty
every asset belongs to the current project
every queued asset source file is currently available

tools.name: generate_storyboard

scope.resolution: projectId and editingTaskId come from LoopState; the domain function revalidates ownership

tools.retryPolicy: do not automatically retry; a repeated invocation can create another storyboard version
preconditions: brief or current task brief is non-empty
editing task belongs to the current project
at least one analyzed media source is available
configured model Provider is available
model output passes local storyboard evidence and source-range validation

tools.name: create_timeline_draft

scope.resolution: the active storyboard from LoopState is passed to the domain function, which revalidates project ownership

tools.retryPolicy: do not automatically retry; a repeated invocation creates another timeline version
preconditions: an active storyboard exists
active storyboard belongs to the current project

tools.name: replace_clips

scope.resolution: timeline is selected only from LoopState; replacement asset lookup includes current projectId and ready analysis status

tools.retryPolicy: do not automatically retry; every successful invocation creates a new timeline version and operation log
preconditions: a scoped timeline can be selected
shot indexes exist and are unique
replacement assets are analyzed and available in the current project
video source range is valid and exactly equals the replaced timeline slot duration
image source range is 0 to 0

tools.name: change_clip_duration

scope.resolution: timeline is selected only from LoopState; asset metadata lookup includes current projectId and ready analysis status

tools.retryPolicy: do not automatically retry; every successful invocation creates a new timeline version and operation log
preconditions: a scoped timeline can be selected
shot indexes exist and are unique
new duration is positive
new video source window stays inside the clip's previously verified source window and technical media duration
image source start remains 0

tools.name: reorder_clips

scope.resolution: timeline is selected only from LoopState

tools.retryPolicy: do not automatically retry; every successful invocation creates a new timeline version and operation log
preconditions: a scoped timeline can be selected
order contains every existing shot index exactly once and contains no unknown index

tools.name: replace_text_tracks

scope.resolution: Rust validates all text cues and creates a new scoped timeline version

tools.retryPolicy: do not automatically retry; every success creates a new version
preconditions: a scoped timeline exists
text tracks pass backend validation

tools.name: replace_music_tracks

scope.resolution: Rust validates source and timeline ranges and creates a new scoped timeline version

tools.retryPolicy: do not automatically retry; every success creates a new version
preconditions: a scoped timeline exists
all audio assets are ready in the current project

tools.name: render_preview

scope.resolution: select only a timeline already scoped into LoopState; the delivery tool never creates one implicitly

tools.retryPolicy: do not automatically replay an interrupted invocation; a fresh request may rerender the scoped timeline
preconditions: a scoped timeline exists
timeline has clips
every referenced source media file is available
FFmpeg is available

tools.name: create_jianying_draft

scope.resolution: select only a timeline already scoped into LoopState; the delivery tool never creates one implicitly

tools.retryPolicy: never automatically replay after interruption; require review or a fresh user request because another draft may already exist
preconditions: a scoped timeline exists
Jianying Pro 8.0 draft library is available
all timeline clips are videos
every referenced source media file is available
adapter and registration safety checks pass

controlActions.name: ask_user
controlActions.effect: ends the loop with a clarification message and no artifact

controlActions.name: finish
controlActions.effect: ends only when the goal's real artifact gate is satisfied; Question may finish with an answer

knownImplementationNotes: skill failures are returned to the model transcript as bounded-loop context; there is not yet a per-tool stable public error-code enum
